title: Adam
tagline: The first of all people: made from earth, taught the names, forgiven.
depictionNotes: Prophet Adam (peace be upon him), Hawwa and their children are shown, all with dark skin, Hawwa's hair covered. The angels are shown only as light with wings and Iblis only as smoke and flame, never with a face. After the eating from the tree, the pictures show leaves, not people. Pictures are AI-generated; until they are ready the pages show icons.
coverAlt: Adam and Hawwa stand together in a bright garden with a great tree, a stream, birds and deer.
